en: The image shows a black-and-white vintage postcard featuring a central street scene in a historic European city. Prominent is a stone bell tower on the left, with a view down a wide pedestrian street lined with old stone buildings and people walking. Hills rise in the background. The upper right contains printed text indicating the city and the name of the street, both in a Slavic language.
